description: Application for a Learner or Permanent Driving License requiring age proof, address proof, and identity verification.

requirements.name: Proof of Age / Date of Birth
requirements.description: Birth Certificate, School Certificate / 10th Marksheet, PAN Card, or Passport verifying applicant is of eligible age (18+ for motor vehicles).
requirements.validation_hints: Date of birth must confirm applicant meets legal age requirement for driving category.

requirements.name: Proof of Current Address
requirements.description: Valid address document such as Aadhaar Card, Electricity Bill, Ration Card, or Bank Statement within the regional transport office (RTO) jurisdiction.
requirements.validation_hints: Current address must match applicant residence.

requirements.name: Identity Proof
requirements.description: Valid government-issued photo identity proof (Aadhaar, Passport, Voter ID, PAN).
requirements.validation_hints: Full name must be spelled identically across all proofs.

requirements.name: Medical Certificate / Fitness Declaration
requirements.description: Form 1-A medical fitness certificate or self-declaration of physical fitness for commercial / non-transport driving.
requirements.validation_hints: Signed by a registered medical practitioner if applicant is above 40 years or applying for transport license.
